records.jp: あ、日菜子ちゃん！　いいところに！！
records.en_original: Oh, Hinako! Perfect timing!!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Hinako! Perfect timing!
records.en: Oh, Hinako-chan! Perfect timing!

records.jp: なあに、早苗？
records.en_original: What's up, Sanae?
records.en_auxiliary: What's up, Sanae?
records.en: What's up, Sanae?

records.jp: 昨日、テレビにホームメイト華族が出てたの！！<CR>それを日菜子ちゃんと話したくって！
records.en_original: The Homemate Crew was on TV yesterday! I wanted to talk to you about it!
records.en_auxiliary: The Homemate Crew was on TV yesterday! I wanted to talk to you about it!
records.en: The Homemate Crew was on TV yesterday!<CR>I wanted to talk about it with you, Hinako-chan!

records.jp: えっと、ホームメイト華族……って何？
records.en_original: Um... What's the Homemate Crew?
records.en_auxiliary: Um... What's the Homemate Crew?
records.en: Um... What's the Homemate Crew?

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん、知らないの！？
records.en_original: You don't know!?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't know?!
records.en: You don't know them, Hinako-chan?!

records.jp: うん、ごめん……
records.en_original: Nope, sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: Nope, sorry.
records.en: Nope, sorry...

records.jp: ホームメイト華族はね、三人組の歌手でね、<CR>出す曲出す曲、いい曲ばっかり！
records.en_original: The Homemate Crew is a group of three singers. Every song they release is great!
records.en_auxiliary: The Homemate Crew is a group of three singers. Every song they release is great!
records.en: The Homemate Crew is a trio of singers,<CR>and every song they release is great!

records.jp: 特に、メロディがなんていうか、<CR>心にしみるっていうか、あと歌詞もね――
records.en_original: Especially their melodies. Oh, how can I put it? It's like thye sink right into your soul, and the lyrics are...
records.en_auxiliary: Especially their melodies. Oh, how can I put it? It's like they sink right into your soul, and the lyrics are...
records.en: Especially the melodies—they're, how should I put it...<CR>like they seep into your heart. And the lyrics—

records.jp: （私、テレビってあんまり見ないけど<CR>それにしても全く聞いたことがないような…）
records.en_original: (I don't really watch much TV, but still, I've never even heard of them...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't really watch much TV, but still, I've never even heard of them.)
records.en: (I don't really watch much TV,<CR>but even so, I've never heard of them at all...)

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん？
records.en_original: You still with me, Hinako?
records.en_auxiliary: You still with me, Hinako?
records.en: Hinako-chan?

records.jp: あ、ごめん。聞いてるよ
records.en_original: Oh, sorry. I'm listening.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, sorry. I'm listening.
records.en: Oh, sorry. I'm listening.

records.jp: えっと、なんだっけ……そうだ、歌詞！<CR>こう心にグサッと刺さるような感じなの
records.en_original: Um, where was I...? Oh right, the lyrics! It's like every word knows just how to pierce your heart.
records.en_auxiliary: Um, where was I? Oh right, the lyrics! It's like every word knows just how to pierce your heart.
records.en: Um, where was I...? Oh, right, the lyrics!<CR>They're the kind that pierce you right in the heart.

records.jp: （早苗、本当にその歌手好きなんだなあ）
records.en_original: (It sounds like Sanae really likes these singers.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It sounds like Sanae really likes these singers.)
records.en: (Sanae really loves this group.)

records.jp: わかった、聞いてみるよ
records.en_original: You've sold me. I'll try listening to them.
records.en_auxiliary: You've sold me. I'll give them a listen.
records.en: Okay, I'll give them a listen.

records.jp: 嬉しい！　今度ＣＤ貸してあげるね
records.en_original: Awesome! I'll lend you a CD sometime.
records.en_auxiliary: Awesome! I'll lend you a CD sometime.
records.en: I'm so glad! I'll lend you a CD sometime.

records.jp: ありがとう
records.en_original: Thanks.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks.
records.en: Thanks.

records.jp: あ、それからね！<CR>もう一つ面白い話があってね――
records.en_original: Oh, also! There was another thing I wanted to talk about...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, also! There was another thing I wanted to talk about...
records.en: Oh, and!<CR>There was another interesting thing—

records.jp: ヒナちゃん！　そろそろ帰ろう？
records.en_original: Hina! Let's get going.
records.en_auxiliary: Hina! Let's get going.
records.en: Hina-chan! Isn't it about time we went home?

records.jp: あ、ユズ
records.en_original: Oh, Yuzu.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Yuzu.
records.en: Oh, Yuzu.

records.jp: あ、苗ちんも一緒だったんだ。<CR>苗ちんも一緒に帰らない？
records.en_original: Ah, Nae's with you too. Wanna come along?
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, Nae's with you, too. Wanna come along?
records.en: Oh, Nae-chin is with you too.<CR>Nae-chin, want to walk home with us?

records.jp: 私は……
早苗？　どうしたの？
records.en_original: Sanae? Are you okay?
records.en_auxiliary: Sanae? Are you okay?
records.en: Sanae? What's wrong?

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん……。<CR>あのね、私、ちゃんと役に立ててるかな？
records.en_original: Hinako... Um, am I of any use to you?
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako... Um, am I of any use to you?
records.en: Hinako-chan...<CR>Um, am I actually being helpful?

records.jp: え？　突然どうしたの？
records.en_original: Huh? What are you talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What are you talking about?
records.en: Huh? Why ask that all of a sudden?

records.jp: 私ずっと文化部だし、今まで競争とかしたこと無いから、<CR>原種と戦う時にどうしたらいいか不安で……
records.en_original: I've always been into crafts instead of competitive stuff, and I don't know how to help fight Sephirot...
records.en_auxiliary: I've always been into crafts instead of competitive stuff, and I don't know how to help fight Sephira.
records.en: I've always been in cultural clubs and I've never competed before,<CR>so I'm worried I won't know what to do when we fight Sephira...

records.jp: そんな！　早苗がいてくれるお陰で助かってるよ
records.en_original: That's not true! Just having you around helps us a lot!
records.en_auxiliary: That's not true! Just having you around helps us a lot!
records.en: No! Having you with us is a huge help!

records.jp: うんうん。そうだよ！
records.en_original: Yeah, that's right!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, that's right!
records.en: Yeah, that's right!

records.jp: でも、普段の活動はどうしても手伝うことができないでしょう？<CR>だから、とても不安で……どうしても遠慮しちゃうし……
records.en_original: But I can't help you with what you actually DO. That's why I feel so uneasy... And end up holding back...
records.en_auxiliary: But I can't help you with what you actually DO. That's why I feel so uneasy. And end up holding back...
records.en: But I can't help with your day-to-day activities, can I?<CR>That makes me so anxious... and I can't help holding back...

records.jp: どうしても、ユズちゃんとライムちゃんに劣等感を抱かずには<CR>いられないの……
records.en_original: I can't help but feel inferior to Yuzu and Lime...
records.en_auxiliary: I can't help but feel inferior to Yuzu and Lime...
records.en: I can't stop myself from feeling inferior<CR>to Yuzu-chan and Lime-chan...

records.jp: 苗ちん……
records.en_original: Nae...
records.en_auxiliary: Nae...
records.en: Nae-chin...

records.jp: ねえ、日菜子ちゃん！　私も力になりたいの！<CR>何かいい方法ない？
records.en_original: So, Hinako? I want to help you, too! Is there any way I can?
records.en_auxiliary: So, Hinako? I want to help you, too! Is there any way I can?
records.en: Hinako-chan! I want to be useful too!<CR>Isn't there some good way?

records.jp: （早苗が自信をつける方法かー……）
records.en_original: (Sanae needs a way to gain confidence...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Sanae needs a way to gain confidence.)
records.en: (A way for Sanae to gain confidence...)

records.jp: うーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: 気持ちだけで十分だよ。<CR>それに、普段からできることってあまり無いと思うし
records.en_original: Your feelings are plenty. Besides, there's not much to do most of the time.
records.en_auxiliary: Your feelings are plenty. Besides, there's not much to do most of the time.
records.en: Your feelings alone are enough.<CR>Besides, I don't think there's much you can do on a regular basis.

records.jp: でも……
records.en_original: But...
records.en_auxiliary: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: だから、やるとしてもイメージトレーニングくらいしか<CR>できないと思う
records.en_original: So, I don't know if there's really anything you could do outside of mental training.
records.en_auxiliary: So, I don't know if there's really anything you could do outside of mental training.
records.en: So even if you tried, I think mental training<CR>would be about all you could do.

records.jp: 気持ちは嬉しいけど――
records.en_original: I'm happy for the offer, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm happy for the offer, but...
records.en: I appreciate the thought, but—

records.jp: イメージトレーニング！　それいいね！
records.en_original: Mental training! That sounds good!
records.en_auxiliary: Mental training! That sounds good!
records.en: Mental training! That sounds good!

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 心の準備って大事だと思うし、ちょっと方法を考えてみるよ
records.en_original: I want to make sure I'm mentally prepared whenever you call on me, so I'll think up some ways to train!
records.en_auxiliary: I want to make sure I'm mentally prepared whenever you call on me, so I'll think up some ways to train!
records.en: I think mental preparation is important, so I'll come up with a way to train.

records.jp: う、うん……
records.en_original: O-Okay...
records.en_auxiliary: O-okay...
records.en: O-Okay...

records.jp: （一体どうするつもりだろう？）
records.en_original: (What exactly is she going to do?)
records.en_auxiliary: (What exactly is she going to do?)
records.en: (What exactly is she going to do?)

records.jp: じゃあ特訓してみる？
records.en_original: Then how about some special training?
records.en_auxiliary: Then how about some special training?
records.en: Then how about some special training?

records.jp: 特訓？
records.en_original: Special training?
records.en_auxiliary: Special training?
records.en: Special training?

records.jp: 早苗、さっき言ってたでしょ？　あまり競争とかしたこと無いって。<CR>だったら何か勝負してみるとかどう？
records.en_original: You just said, you don't have any competitive experience. Maybe we should have some sort of match to help you out.
records.en_auxiliary: You just said, you don't have any competitive experience. Maybe we should have some sort of match to help you out.
records.en: You said it yourself, Sanae—you've never really competed before.<CR>So how about trying some kind of contest?

records.jp: そうすれば自信もつくんじゃない？
records.en_original: It might help you gain a little confidence.
records.en_auxiliary: It might help you gain a little confidence.
records.en: It might help you gain a little confidence.

records.jp: なるほど！　でも、何で勝負すればいいんだろう……？
records.en_original: I like it! But what kind of match would it be...?
records.en_auxiliary: I like it! But what kind of match would it be?
records.en: I see! But what should we compete at...?

records.jp: あまり難しく考えなくていいんじゃない？<CR>早苗の好きなもので考えればいいと思うよ
records.en_original: We don't need an answer right now. Just follow your heart and go with whatever you like.
records.en_auxiliary: We don't need an answer right now. Just follow your heart and go with whatever you like.
records.en: You don't have to overthink it.<CR>Just choose something you like, Sanae.

records.jp: そうだね。じゃあ考えてみるよ
records.en_original: You're right. I'll think of something.
records.en_auxiliary: You're right. I'll think of something.
records.en: You're right. I'll think of something.
